parts.tooltip: Reader r a — a computation waiting for env r; when run with r it produces a
(a ⟶ Reader r b) — continuation: given a, produces a new computation waiting for r
r — the shared read-only environment. bind supplies THE SAME r to ra and to f(a). It is never modified.
bind ra f = \\r -> f (ra r) r\nRun ra with env r to get a. Pass a to f. Run f(a) with the SAME env r.
Reader r b — the composed computation; when run with r it produces b
